title: Enrolment batch selection + toolbar + batch API endpoint
content:
Add batch selection and operations to the enrolments admin page.

## Batch API: POST /api/admin/enrolments/batch (new)
- Body: `{ action: "APPROVE" | "REJECT", ids: string[], reason?: string }`
- Validation: check all target IDs are PENDING_VERIFICATION; skip already-processed ones with warning
- Return `{ updatedCount: number, skippedCount: number, skippedIds: string[] }`
- On APPROVE: trigger receipt PDF generation + email for each approved enrolment (reuse existing logic from PATCH /api/admin/enrolments/[id])
- Admin role guard

## UI changes
### EnrolmentRow.tsx
- Add checkbox as first cell
- For group enrolments: selecting parent selects all child rows (or treat group as single selectable unit)

### Page.tsx — batch toolbar
- Add "select all" checkbox in table header (selects all on current page only)
- Show batch toolbar when ≥1 row selected: "{count} selected" + Batch Approve + Batch Reject buttons
- Batch Approve: confirmation dialog with count summary
- Batch Reject: use existing RejectDialog (with reason), extended to show selected count
- On success: toast with updated count, clear selection, refresh list

## i18n — NEW dict keys needed (add to all 3 locales)
- batchApprove: "Batch Approve"
- batchReject: "Batch Reject"
- selectedCount: "{count} selected"
- selectAll: "Select All"
- batchConfirmApprove: "Approve {count} selected enrolment(s)?"
- batchConfirmReject: "Reject {count} selected enrolment(s)?"
- batchSuccess: "{count} enrolment(s) updated"
- batchPartial: "{updated} updated, {skipped} skipped (already processed)"

States:
- No selection: toolbar hidden
- Selection active: toolbar visible with count + action buttons
- Submitting: buttons disabled with loading spinner per action
- Success: toast + clear selection + refetch
- Error: toast with error details
acceptance: POST /api/admin/enrolments/batch accepts { action, ids, reason? }, returns { updatedCount, skippedCount, skippedIds }
Batch endpoint skips non-PENDING_VERIFICATION enrolments with warning
Checkbox column renders in each EnrolmentRow
Select-all checkbox in header selects/deselects all visible rows
Batch toolbar shows selection count + Approve/Reject buttons
Batch Approve triggers receipt generation for each approved enrolment
Batch Reject prompts for reason (reuses RejectDialog semantics)
All new labels use dict keys (i18n)
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
dependencies: AD-006-SEARCH: search input + API search param must be in place before batch toolbar (they share the same UI area).
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && select rows, batch approve/reject works, skipped enrolments handled correctly.
